_note: Cowork plugin manifest for the close-obsidian-project companion skill. Installed standalone via URL paste in Cowork (the main obsidian-company-memory install skill also tries to auto-install this on Code via copy-to-~/.claude/skills/ — see SKILL.md Substep 5.6). Bundled inside the obsidian-company-memory repository at companion-skills/close-obsidian-project/.
name: Close Obsidian Project
description: Close a working session against an Obsidian Company Memory vault project. Use at the end of every session — even short ones. Triggers on 'close out the session', 'close-obsidian-project', 'wrap up the session', 'end this session', '/close-obsidian-project', or any close paraphrase. Updates the project brief's session log if one exists, verifies at least one Ingest happened, appends a dated entry to the vault's log.md, reports every KB write made this session, generates a copy-paste continuation prompt for the next session, and prints a structured close report. Named close-obsidian-project (not close-session) so it can coexist with any other close or close session skill you may have for non-Obsidian work.

directory_access.scope: the OCM vault folder (to read SCHEMA.md + the session's working files, and to write a dated log.md entry) AND the project folder if a brief.md exists there (to append a new row to the Session Log table). The skill never writes outside the vault and the active project folder.
writes: <vault>/log.md (append one dated entry at the top of the file)
<project>/brief.md (append one row to the Session Log table — only if a brief exists)
reads: <vault>/{entities,concepts,comparisons,queries}/*.md (to verify at least one Ingest happened this session)

_parent_bundle_note: This skill is a companion to the main obsidian-company-memory install skill. The main skill scaffolds the vault; this skill closes working sessions cleanly and writes the audit trail entry. Companion-skill naming uses the -obsidian-project suffix to avoid collisions with the user's existing close / close-session / close-out skills for non-Obsidian work. The skill closes a session (not the project itself); the naming uses 'project' for namespace uniqueness only.

_install_paths.code: auto-installed by the main obsidian-company-memory install skill (copies companion-skills/close-obsidian-project/ to ~/.claude/skills/). Manual install: git clone the repo + cp -r the folder.
_install_paths.cowork: install standalone via this plugin.json URL paste in Cowork's plugin install field. The main skill triggers this install path during scaffold; if the multi-skill plugin manifest isn't honored, fall back to the user pasting this URL directly.
_install_paths.codex_opencode: no native skill mechanism; append SKILL.md body to ~/.codex/AGENTS.md (or equivalent) under a 'Custom skills' section, or reference from the project's session stub.
